title: 290 Sentences and 169 Idiom Tags Across 13 Chapters
subtitle: Output of prepare-chapters.ts, by chapter number
caption: Sentences are split on the characters 。！？ and idioms are tagged by substring match against a hand-written list of 28 entries. Chapters 1 and 8 have more tags than sentences because one sentence can contain several terms. Regeneration is deterministic and needs no API key.
